identity.display_note: MQTTium AsyncClient (https://pypi.org/project/mqttium/) — async-native MQTT 3.1.1/5; QoS0 via publish_nowait on the owning loop (PyPI ≥1.0.0rc11). Through 1.0.0rc14, QoS>=1 uses on_publish armed lazily so the direct QoS0 write stays available. From 1.0.0rc15, QoS>=1 uses PublishReceipt.wait(). Native message_callback_add.

private_api.PublishReceipt._waiters / PublishReceipt: 1.0.0rc15 removed on_publish. QoS>=1 completion is observed by registering one future on the receipt, which is what PublishReceipt.wait does, and reading _error when it resolves. A Task per publish would be a harness tax rc14 does not pay.
